title: Plasma Computer Containment (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Containment is a wall made of pure force: fields hold plasma off every solid surface. The Signature extension replaces nested copper coils with printed field-lattice sheets: thin flexible conductor meshes whose current pattern is rewritten by software, so one physical bottle can morph between cell shapes on demand. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
